rendererInfo.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER (0x00002689) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

visualReview: Verifier must inspect fresh independent side/oblique/top source vs candidate evidence before PASS_LOCAL_PROMOTE

jaw.reason: Original thin source triangle27216 has true face gradient495.738/m and2.3167 area ratio under rejected graph-distance jaw field; vertex averages cannot pass this gate

oralFieldProof.fieldMeaning: Gill only: original source-positive domains and quintic C2 collar over original graph, source cross-domain triangles zero. Jaw explicitly disabled; gill motion must not be called mouth opening. No new topology or cavity.

visualInspection.observations: Fresh actual head captures retain the original ocular shapes and pupils and show distinct pupil directions. Native mouths preserve continuous source skin. Screenshot review does not override a failed full-surface GPU gate or certify species motion.

knownLimitations: Only two native tuna jaws are source-confirmed and GPU-checked. Four other jaws remain HOLD_LOCAL; legacy gill must also remain neutral if its actual recessed-surface GPU gate fails.
Optical excursion is not increased for every source compared with generic R03 eye mapping; visible saccade/hold behavior is a candidate for user evaluation.
Original source texture resolutions remain unchanged.
Desktop actual GPU and mobile viewport are tested; no physical mobile device test or universal 60 FPS guarantee.
